title: 第21章 冲击人榜试炼天梯第22章 人榜前十
content_zh:
须知道，在真武境就修炼出五十四牛之力，绝对是举世罕见的妖孽存在。
哪怕放眼整个大赵王朝，都屈指可数。
“天啊，竟是六九极限！”
“这秦玄到底何方神圣，居然在真武境就达到了六九极限，就算是号称百年以来天赋最超绝的天子殿下，也足足是十八岁时，才修炼到这一阶段。”
“简直就是妖孽啊！”
天元武府所有人彻底被秦玄的强大所震撼了。
他们都是全国各地的武道天才，之前就被秦玄逐一击败了。
虽然心里佩服秦玄的强大，但也仅仅佩服而已。
对于曾在天元武府这个天才无数的修炼圣地中，见识过众多妖孽的他们，秦玄此前表现虽强，但在天元武府中依旧无法排入前十，不足以让他们敬畏。
可刚才一战，那六九极限的五十四牛之力一出现，就直接让狂刚被击败了。
他们给彻底惊震了，发自内心地开始敬畏眼前这个少年。
达到六九极限者，放眼在天元武府内，在真武境这一境界中排入前十丝毫不难，甚至能够争锋前三。
正是如此，才为之敬畏。
几乎每一届的真武境前三者，不出意外，将来都有超过三成希望封王称尊。
而封王称尊者，可是大赵王朝最顶尖一列的强者，可谓王朝的擎天巨擘。
与此同时，人级武斗场内，一道身影踏空而现，看上去四十岁出头，脸白无须，气质儒雅，身披华服，无风自动。
出现的那一刻，顿时引起了各方惊呼。
“柳塔主居然出现了！”
“没想到居然惊动了柳塔主这位超级强者出现，柳塔主可是素来神龙见首不见尾。”
“不是说柳塔主去了万妖山脉吗，怎么会出现在这里？”

“别忘了，狂刚可是柳塔主的亲传弟子。
秦玄击败了狂刚，惊动柳塔主出现也是理所当然。”
柳乘风，不仅仅是天峰城分塔的塔主，掌握莫大的权势，连天峰城城主都要敬他三分。
更为重要的是，他还是一位超脱了天罡境之上的超级强者，修为深不可测，传闻即将封王称尊。
柳乘风从天而降，落在了武斗擂台上。
柳师也是惊讶，没想到惊动了这位天峰城分塔的塔主，于是亲自上前，作揖行礼：“韵诗见过柳叔。”
柳乘风微微一笑，让人如沐春风：“原来是韵诗来了，不知道你父亲如何？”
柳韵诗道：“柳叔有心了，家父一切安康。”
“那就好。”
“师尊，是我败了，有愧您的厚望。”
狂刚面露惭愧之色，低下了脑袋。
他可是柳乘风的亲传弟子，被给予了厚望，甚至当初拒绝了天元武府，自问同辈难寻敌手，没想到却在自家主场就被击败了，而且败得如此之快。
仅仅一个照面，就被这秦玄给击败了。
“小刚，莫要自责，你已经做得很好了。”
柳乘风勉励了狂刚一句，而后看向秦玄。
“晚辈见过柳塔主。”
秦玄抱拳，并未像一般人那样朝柳乘风鞠躬行礼。
他能够感觉到，眼前这位柳乘风的强大，远超在大长老亲沧溟之上不知何几。
content_en:
You must know that someone who has developed the power of fifty-four oxen in the True Martial Realm is definitely a rare evil being in the world.
Even if we look at the entire Zhao Dynasty, there are only a handful of them.
"Oh my god, it's the limit of sixty-nine!"
"Who is this Qin Xuan? He actually reached the limit of sixty-nine in the True Martial Realm. Even His Highness the Emperor, who is said to have the most extraordinary talent in a hundred years, did not reach this stage until he was eighteen years old."
"He is simply a monster!"
Everyone in Tianyuan Martial House was completely shocked by Qin Xuan's power.
They are all martial arts geniuses from all over the country, and they were defeated one by one by Qin Xuan before.
Although I admire Qin Xuan's strength in my heart, it's just admiration.
For them, who had seen many monsters in Tianyuan Martial Palace, a training holy land with countless geniuses, although Qin Xuan's previous performance was strong, he still could not be ranked among the top ten in Tianyuan Martial Palace, and was not enough to awe them.
But in the battle just now, Kuang Gang was defeated as soon as the sixty-nine limit of fifty-four bulls of power appeared.
They were completely shocked and began to awe the young man in front of them from the bottom of their hearts.
For those who have reached the limit of sixty-nine, looking at the Tianyuan Martial Palace, it is not difficult to rank among the top ten in the realm of Zhenwu Realm, and can even compete for the top three.
That's why I'm in awe of it.
In almost every session, more than 30% of the top three in the True Martial Realm hope to be crowned king in the future.
And those who are called kings and venerable are the top strong men in the Zhao Dynasty, and can be said to be the giants of the dynasty.
At the same time, in the human-level martial arts arena, a figure appeared out of the air. He looked to be in his early forties, with a white face and a beardless face. He had an elegant temperament, was dressed in luxurious clothes, and acted automatically in the wind.
The moment it appeared, it immediately aroused exclamations from all parties.
"Master Liu Tower actually appeared!"
"I didn't expect that the super strong master Liu Pagoda appeared. Master Liu Pagoda has always seen the dragon but never saw its end."
"Didn't it say that Lord Liu Pagoda went to the Ten Thousand Demons Mountains? How could he appear here?"
"Don't forget, Kuang Gang is Liu Pagoda Master's personal disciple.
Qin Xuan defeated Kuang Gang, and it was natural for him to alert Master Liu Pagoda to show up. "
Liu Chengfeng is not only the tower master of the sub-tower of Tianfeng City, but also holds great power. Even the master of Tianfeng City must respect him.
More importantly, he is also a super strong man who has transcended the Tiangang realm. His cultivation is unfathomable, and it is rumored that he will soon be crowned king.
Liu Chengfeng fell from the sky and landed on the martial arts arena.
Master Liu was also surprised. He didn't expect to alarm the tower owner of Tianfeng City's sub-tower, so he stepped forward in person and saluted: "Yun Shi has met Uncle Liu."
Liu Chengfeng gave a faint smile, which made people feel like spring breeze: "It turns out that Yun Shi is here. I wonder how your father is doing?"
Liu Yunshi said: "Uncle Liu is thoughtful, and my father will be well."
"That's good."
"Master, it was me who failed, and I did not live up to your high expectations."
Kuang Gang looked ashamed and lowered his head.
He was Liu Chengfeng's direct disciple, and he was given high hopes. He even rejected Tianyuan Martial Palace at the beginning, thinking that it would be difficult to find an opponent among his peers. Unexpectedly, he was defeated at his home court, and he lost so quickly.
After just one meeting, he was defeated by Qin Xuan.
"Xiao Gang, don't blame yourself, you have done a good job."
Liu Chengfeng encouraged Kuang Gang and then looked at Qin Xuan.
"Junior has met Master Liu Tower."
Qin Xuan clasped his fists and did not bow to Liu Chengfeng like ordinary people.
He could feel that the Liu Chengfeng in front of him was far more powerful than the great elder himself Cangming.
